# hookbase_transform (Resource)

Manages a Hookbase transform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# JSONata transform to normalize Stripe events
resource "hookbase_transform" "stripe_normalize" {
  name           = "normalize-stripe"
  transform_type = "jsonata"
  code           = <<-EOT
    {
      "event_type": type,
      "customer_id": data.object.customer,
      "amount": data.object.amount / 100,
      "currency": data.object.currency,
      "timestamp": created
    }
  EOT
}

# JavaScript transform for complex logic
resource "hookbase_transform" "enrich_payload" {
  name           = "enrich-payload"
  transform_type = "javascript"
  code           = file("${path.module}/transforms/enrich.js")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Transform code.
- `name` (String) Transform name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Transform description.
- `input_format` (String) Input format: json, xml, or text.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the transform is active.
- `output_format` (String) Output format: json, xml, or text.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier. Auto-generated from name if not provided. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `transform_type` (String) Transform type: jsonata, xslt, liquid, or javascript.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Transform ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
